text:
anya: quick design review: we keep getting feedback that the evals "approval" action is overloaded. proposal: introduce an approval spectrum (micro-actions) instead of a binary button: "Fast pass", "Save to audit", and "Request follow-up". intent is to make intent explicit and reduce accidental permanent sign-offs.

clara: sketch in figma linked. layout idea: inline compact menu on each result row with three choices. primary CTA remains Fast pass for speed. Save to audit opens a compact confirmation sheet that explains snapshot behavior. Request follow-up opens a tiny comment composer to attach to the test.

diego: backend implications: Save to audit needs an event plus snapshot_url. Request follow-up should create a comment thread entity. We'll add event name evals.approval.spectrum.v1. payload fields: user_id, mode: fast|audit|followup, prompt_set_sha, item_ids. snapshot for audit only. cheap change but need to think about rate of snapshots in bulk flows.

zoe: accessibility notes: a compact menu with three items should be keyboard navigable and expose role="menu" semantics or a segmented control with proper aria-pressed states. If we use a menu, ensure each menuitem has descriptive text and aria-describedby linking to consequence text. For the audit flow, use alertdialog that reads a short summary and includes an accessible link to the audit transcript.

pete: research insight: reviewers sometimes want a middle ground between fast and audit: "save a pointer" without full archive. Request follow-up maps to that. Also, micro-actions reduce cognitive load vs two large buttons. We'll A/B test.

clara: copy proposals (short):
- Fast pass
- Save to audit
- Request follow-up
Longer helper copy visible on hover/focus: "Fast pass: mark test as passed locally. Save to audit: create immutable audit entry with snapshot. Request follow-up: leave a note for a signer to review."

anya: copy nits: shorten to "Save + audit" vs "Save to audit"? shorter is easier on narrow screens.

clara: ok try "Save + audit" in the compact menu. helper text below the menu will clarify.

zoe: keyboard shortcuts idea: when a row is focused, pressing A = Fast pass, S = Save + audit, R = Request follow-up. But using single-letter shortcuts can conflict; prefer modifiers: Mod+F, Mod+S, Mod+R and display hint. Also require an explicit confirmation for Save + audit to avoid accidental triggers. Announce shortcut keys in the accessible help overlay.

diego: telemetry: include trigger: ui|shortcut|api and confirmation: true|false. For bulk Save + audit above threshold N (configurable, default 200) we switch to archive flow and include archive_url.

pete: testing plan: 8 users for discoverability (including 2 screen reader), track false-positive audits, time-to-action, and percent use of follow-up. We'll recruit from current beta customers.

clara: visual focus plan: when the compact menu opens, trap focus inside until a choice or escape. For Save + audit confirmation, show small inline summary with count and affected domains. Avoid long transcripts in the modal; provide a link to archived bundle. Ensure color contrast meets tokens.

zoe: ARIA specifics to add to PR: role="menu" plus aria-label="Approval actions", menuitems with aria-describedby pointing to an offscreen description id that spells consequences, alertdialog with aria-labelledby and aria-describedby for the confirmation. Use aria-live polite on completion: "Saved X items to audit. Audit ID: XYZ". Toast should be programmatically focusable.

diego: dev estimate: UI + shortcuts + telemetry ~3 days, backend snapshot + archive + events ~2 days, QA and feature flag ~1 day. Recommend feature-flagged rollout per-org.

anya: rollout: feature flag, beta to compliance-heavy orgs first. metrics: audit rate, undo within 5 min, follow-up creation rate. Fail open to current behavior if flag off.

automation-bot: Created ticket #5333: "e(v)als approval spectrum: UI + audit + follow-up" and assigned to diego.

clara: action items: @diego open schema PR for evals.approval.spectrum.v1, @zoe add a11y checklist to PR template, @pete schedule usability sessions. I'll refine figma and post link.

anya: decision: proceed with approval spectrum in compact menu with explicit Save + audit confirmation and accessible shortcuts. behind flag, beta rollout.

zoe: small extra nit: include a data-attribute on menu items (data-approval-mode) so assistive tech / testing harnesses can assert semantics easily.

diego: ack. starting branch tomorrow.

clara: thanks all ":sparkles:" will post updated mocks when branch is up.
